rawContent: This is a defining moment for all the feminists and #MeToo advocates to address the toxic masculinity shown by Jeffrey Epstein and abuse that many underage girls(and possibly boys)were forced to endure.The deafening silence thus far, compared to now Justice Kavanaugh is stunning.
